title: by the time / before / when 作参照

examples.en: By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
examples.zh: 等我们到那儿时，商店已经关门了。

examples.en: He had finished the work before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前他已经把活干完了。

guess.question: 这两个句子里的 by the time、before 起什么作用？

options.text: 给出“到什么时候为止”的参照点，说明动作在那之前就完成了
options.feedback: 对！参照点一出现，比它更早的动作用 had + 过去分词。
不对——句子里 got / finished 都是过去的事。
不对——它们是时间标志，不是 because 那样的因果词。

rule.rule: by the time / before / when 引出的过去时间是参照点，在它之前完成的动作用过去完成时
signals: by the end of last term
rule.formula: by the time / before + 过去时间，主句用 had + 过去分词

anchors.en: By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
anchors.zh: 等我们到那儿时，商店已经关门了。

anchors.en: He had finished the work before lunch.
anchors.zh: 午饭前他已经把活干完了。

trap.wrong: By the time we got there, the shop has closed.
trap.right: By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
trap.why: 参照点 got there 是过去，所以要用 had 而不是 has。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——看到 by the time / before，先找参照点，更早的动作用 had done。

check.stem: By the time I was twelve, I ____ (learn) 800 English words.

options.distractor: 这里要说“到十二岁为止已经学会”，用过去完成时

check.explanation: “到十二岁时”是过去参照点，更早完成的动作用 had learned。

check.stem: The plane ____ (take) off before we arrived at the airport.

options.distractor: 起飞发生在到达之前，是更早的动作

check.explanation: 飞机在我们到达前就起飞了，用 had taken off。

options.text: He had left before I came.
He has left before I came.
options.distractor: 参照点是过去（came），要用 had

options.text: He had leave before I came.
options.distractor: had 后面要接过去分词 left

options.text: He was leave before I came.

check.explanation: “我来到之前他就走了”，用 had left。
